# Accusharp Cutlery Service

> Mobile knife sharpening in Southern California. We drive to home kitchens, restaurants, butcher shops, caterers and food trucks and sharpen on-site. Owner-operated by Omar since October 2004. Authorized Victorinox and Messermeister dealer. Slogan: "Never a Dull Moment".

## Contact

- Phone / text: (310) 420-1147
- Email: info@accusharpcutlery.com
- Website: https://accusharpcutlery.com
- Book online: https://accusharpcutlery.com/booking
- Yelp: https://www.yelp.com/biz/accusharp-cutlery-service-los-angeles

## Pricing (home service)

- 1 to 8 knives: $80 flat (the minimum visit)
- 9 to 19 knives: $10 per knife
- 20 or more knives: $8 per knife
- Every knife type is the same price: kitchen, chef, paring, cleavers, serrated, Japanese single-bevel, pocket and hunting knives, scissors and shears
- Same-day service: +$40, subject to route availability
- Restaurant and commercial accounts: volume pricing by quote, with weekly, bi-weekly or monthly routes
- Payment is due after the work is done: cash, credit/debit card, Venmo or Zelle

## Service area

- Los Angeles County, Orange County, Ventura County, and parts of the Inland Empire
- Zone 1 (no travel fee): most of Los Angeles County and northern Orange County, including Los Angeles, Long Beach, Santa Monica, Pasadena, Beverly Hills, Anaheim and Huntington Beach
- Zone 2 (+$15 per visit): south Orange County (Irvine, Laguna, Newport Beach), outer San Fernando Valley, northern Ventura County
- Zone 3 (+$30 to $50 per visit): far Ventura, parts of the Inland Empire, San Clemente / Dana Point

## How it works

1. Book online, call or text. We confirm within 24 hours.
2. We come to you and sharpen on-site. Most home appointments take about 30 minutes.
3. Every knife gets a full bevel restoration and finish strop, with an edge warranty: not razor sharp, or the edge fails under normal use within 30 days, and we re-sharpen free.
